tools.name: github-repos.setup
tools.description: Write the repo list and interval from github-repos/config. Does not sync.

tools.name: github-repos.check
tools.description: Check the github-repos unit recorded by github-repos.setup.

tools.name: github-repos.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the github-repos folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state github-repos.setup wrote.
